lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: (Yawns.) I'm so sleepy... It's only 6:24 a.m. I still have more than an hour before my shift starts. Did I arrive a little too early?

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: (Looking half-dead.) Morning, Avril. Did you sleep well last night?

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Not really. The monster I fought last night was a real pain. By the time I got back to my apartment, it was already late, and after taking a shower it was past two in the morning. Anyway, I'd better get everything ready for the shift handover... You don't look so great either. What happened at the café yesterday?

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: A drunk guy came in during the early hours of the morning and asked for a hot milk to sober up. But he had obviously drunk way too much. I'm absolutely sure he never threw up in the restroom at the bar before coming here. One more glass of hot milk would've made his stomach explode.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: I think I already know where this is going.

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: He barely took a few sips before he started vomiting. Luckily, I saw it coming the moment I handed him the milk. The instant he lifted his head and looked like he was about to puke, I punched him right in the face.

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: That way, none of the vomit splashed onto the furniture. It all landed neatly on the floor. Cleaning up the mess, and dragging that unconscious drunk out, took a ridiculous amount of effort. Then I still had to calm down the other frightened customers.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Compared to that, I'd rather fight two more monsters like the one from last night than deal with an idiot like him.

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: Honestly, I should ask the boss to hire another server or two... Or maybe just hand in my resignation.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: No, no, senpai—you can't leave yet! I'm still not familiar with how the café operates. At least when the boss was around, he could guide me. The boss had to return to headquarters for a few days, so you're the only one left who can help me. My paycheck has already been docked so many times because of my mistakes that there's barely anything left.

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: Well, well... I guess I just can't say no to such an adorable kohai. Alright then, let's go through the workflow one more time. (Coffee Shop Management Tutorial)

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: Well then, I'm heading out. If you run into any problems, just give me a call.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Got it, senpai! Thanks for all your help!
